ashby:abacum:8d4f97b9-3eec-4a82-8ea7-63d.summary:
Abacum is the AI-native business planning platform for scaling enterprises. We bring an organization's data, business logic, and business context into one governed place, and put agents to work on it. Most planning platforms were built for a finance team to manage and maintain by hand, with AI added later. Abacum was built for AI to do the work from day one, so finance can steer the business every week instead of reporting on it every quarter.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities . Headquartered in New York , we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex , and hundreds more.

sections.title: About Abacum
paras: We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners , with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator , Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.
Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

sections.title: The role
paras: Abacum ships fast, and every launch deserves a story that cuts through. We're hiring a Product Marketing Manager to run our major launches from brief to market , own the product content we publish across video, web and blog, and get it in front of the right buyers through our distribution engine.

You'll design the launch programs that put Abacum in front of finance leaders, write the messaging, and set the quality bar for everything we publish , for people and for the AI engines that now answer buyers' questions. You'll hit the ground running with minimal ramp, and you'll use AI every day to excel.

You won't do it alone. You'll report to the Head of Product Marketing and work alongside a product marketer focused on product and field readiness, a Solutions Consulting team with deep finance expertise, and Growth, Partners and Design teams who run the channels. That frees you to focus on what you do best: marketing that moves the market.
bullets: Reports to: Matthew Sledge , Head of Product Marketing
Focus: Launches, content and distribution
Background: Product marketing at a fast-moving B2B software company. Finance or office-of-the-CFO experience is a strong plus

sections.title: Launches
bullets: Run our major product launches end to end: take the product brief and own the messaging, launch plan, assets and coordination across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Growth and Design.
Design launch programs that cut through the market: the story, the angle and the offer. Then hand off smoothly to Growth, who run the campaigns and channels.
Write launch messaging within Abacum's positioning, including the core story and headline options other teams can build from.
Build the sales kit for every launch: talk tracks, one-pagers, BDR snippets and objection handling, working with GTM Enablement.
Turn product capabilities into finance use cases buyers recognize: budgeting, forecasting, headcount planning, board reporting and variance analysis.

sections.title: Content and distribution
bullets: Be the central owner of Abacum's product content across video, web and blog, from the content calendar to the final cut.
Own content quality for people first and for AI second: keep the inputs AI answer engines draw on (AEO) accurate, clear and current with our value props and positioning.
Review content drafted by other teams, say what's wrong with it and fix it.

B uild our content strategy and distribution with channel owners: know every channel we have, how to use each one, and how to get our product content maximum impact in market, including our prospect newsletter.
Turn customer proof into stories, videos and web content.
Automate the tactical with AI , so your time goes to strategy and story.

ashby:altis:e9065d92-625d-492a-8aa6-cffd.summary:
Altis is a venture intelligence platform that helps investors make faster, better decisions on Series A/B/C companies. We conduct deep primary research — expert interviews with customers, competitors, and industry specialists — to build the analysis that drives investment committee decisions.

We’re backed by Primary Venture Partners, co-founded by a Midas-list investor, and scaling quickly. We’re a lean, high-ownership team building from the ground up. If you want to be close to the action in venture and learn how the best investors and operators think, this is the role.

paras: The Network & Client Services team is the engine of the Altis research process. As an Associate, you’ll identify, engage, and recruit industry experts whose insights help fuel our research and help clients uncover information they cannot access elsewhere. This is a frontline role: you’ll be on the phone and in your inbox daily, building relationships with some of the most interesting people across the fastest-growing, AI-native startups in the world. You won’t be filing reports. You’ll be building a network.

sections.title: What We’re Looking For
paras: You’re early in your career but not early in your ambition. You’ve spent 1–3 years in a role that required you to hustle — sales, business development, recruiting, consulting, or something in between. You know how to pick up the phone, take initiative, and follow through. You’ll thrive here if you:
bullets: Are energized by working toward goals on a tight timeline
Can quickly earn trust with sophisticated, high-caliber professionals
Are naturally curious about AI, startups, and venture capital, and want to understand the ecosystem deeply
Operate with urgency and take ownership of outcomes, not just activity
Are organized enough to manage a pipeline without losing the human side of relationship building
Bring humility and an eagerness to learn

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Source and identify industry experts whose backgrounds match the needs of each research project
Run high-volume outreach by phone and email to engage and recruit experts on tight timelines
Qualify experts and schedule them into client conversations, managing logistics end to end
Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects, keeping follow-through tight so opportunities don’t go cold
Build lasting relationships with experts so they return for future research

sections.title: Requirements
bullets: 1–3 years of experience in a client-facing or outbound role (investment research, expert networks, recruiting, BD, or similar)
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Track record of hitting targets in a metrics-driven environment
Bachelor’s degree
Authorization to work in the United States

ashby:artemis:99b437ba-d96d-4d9f-81fe-9c.summary:
Artemis is building the future of AI-driven cybersecurity, helping companies defend themselves effectively in an era where AI is fighting AI on the cyber battlefield.

Our platform brings a new approach to the $100B security operations market, building a live model of each customer's environment and using AI agents to detect, investigate, hunt, and respond to threats at machine speed. Just one year after our founding, Artemis is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies of all time, with customers including multiple Fortune 500 companies, Global 2000 enterprises, and AI innovators like Cursor.

We have raised $70M from Felicis, First Round Capital, Theory Ventures, Two Sigma Ventures, Lockstep VC and Brightmind. We are also backed by some of the most prominent operators in cybersecurity, including the CEO of Crowdstrike, the former CEO and CTO of Splunk, and the founders of…

sections.title: Job Overview
paras: As a Founding Product Manager at Artemis, you will shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our AI-native cybersecurity platform. You'll work directly with our co-founders and across engineering, design, security, and AI/ML to turn Artemis' technical capabilities into products that change how companies defend themselves.

We're looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply curious about the frontier of AI, and passionate about building products that elegantly balance technical depth with intuitive user experiences. You'll need to be both hands-on with prototyping and comfortable translating complex detection and analytics systems into clear, human-centered solutions that security practitioners actually want to use.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for core areas of the Artemis platform - from detection and analytics to agentic workflows.
Drive high-velocity execution with a world-class team of engineers and designers, balancing principled intuition with data-driven decision making.

Marry customer insights with technical possibilities - deeply understand the workflows of CISOs, SOC analysts, and security engineers, and craft intuitive experiences that abstract away the complexity of large-scale security data.
Prototype using tools like Claude Code and Cursor to accelerate the product development and provide clarity to your vision.
Write evals , together with our engineering and research, in order to ensure the product meets customer needs
Bring insights from AI research, cybersecurity trends, and the evolving threat landscape and apply to Artemis' product.
Contribute to the evolution of Artemis' product practices as we scale and grow the team.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: Minimum 3 years of product management experience.
Prior experience as a software engineer or security engineer strongly preferred
Must: At least 2 of work years in a SIEM, SOAR, or threat detection cybersecurity vendor.
Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on research and tools.
Fluency with core LLM concepts and systems - prompting, embeddings, retrieval, and evals - and the judgment to translate these into reliable, user-facing products.
BA/BS in a technical or analytical field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences, or related).
Strong customer empathy and design thinking - especially for technical end users who are skeptical of tools that don't respect their expertise.
Fluency with modern engineering tools and design tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Figma).

sections.title: Why Work at Artemis?
paras:
Compensation
We offer a competitive compensation of 200,000$-250,000$ per year, and a top-of-market equity component. A variety of factors are considered when determining the compensation, including a candidate’s professional experience. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed.
bullets: Make a real world impact. Help empower cybersecurity teams around the world to keep people safe from the most advanced cyber threats.

Be challenged to be better than ever before . Our team includes some of the smartest and most driven people in the world. We guarantee you will learn more in 1 year here than 10 years in another place.

Push the boundaries of technology. Work with and build the most advanced AI capabilities in the world of cybersecurity including cutting-edge analytics and agentic platforms. Your ideas will shape the product and the industry.

sections.title: Meet Benevity
paras: As the "product and technology expert", the Solution Consultant supports the Sales Team in preparing for and executing tailored product demonstrations for prospects and clients. This includes participating in all required aspects of the Sales process including discovery, demonstration, solution design, contracting, and transition to implementation. The Solution Consultant will also take the lead on the information security review process, support requests for proposal, support follow up requests through the selling process, contribute to the creation of a statement of work and support the growth of existing clients. Examples of standard meetings that the Solution Consultant will participate in with prospects and clients are: product demonstrations, deep dive functional reviews, technology overviews, implementation preparation, proof of concept or solution presentations, proposal follow-up and contracting conversations.

To maintain their expertise in our products and services, the Solution Consultant will be in a constant state of learning and development. It is key to success that Solution Consultants are apprised of all product enhancements, process changes, successful solution deployments and updates to our technology and security infrastructure.
If making an impact matters to you, and working with a company that helps clients to change the world sounds like an exciting adventure, then read on!

sections.title: What You’ll Do?
paras: The TSC’s responsibilities can be grouped into 3 main focus areas covering deal support, deal transition and enablement:
bullets:
Deal Support

• Prepare and deliver targeted product demonstrations designed to address a prospects specific needs
Gain buyer acceptance by explaining and demonstrating the fit of the Benevity solution through proof of concept (POC) solutions
Expedite the Sales process by clearly articulating technology and business process differentiators through product demonstrations, presentations and ad-hoc conversations

Work with prospects and internal technical resources to complete the security evaluation stage of the buying cycle. This includes completing questionnaires, risk assessments and joining meetings with prospects to address questions
Gather and articulate important client information through internal channels (Salesforce, Confluence) to build a strong client profile

Deal Transition

• Work with Account Executives to understand buyer requirements, document scope within a Statement of Work and support the transition to the Implementation team
Bridge the gap between sales and client services to reduce implementation timelines and improve visibility into resource allocation and planning

Proactive problem-solver with strong analytical thinking and creative solution design

Proficient in tools like Google Workspace, Asana, Loopio, and Salesforce

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.
If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

ashby:canvas-medical:a511d7b6-1dd6-45c3-.summary:
Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation. We create modern, elegant front- and back-end tooling to enable new ways for developers and clinicians to integrate data, automate workflows, and collaborate to solve healthcare's toughest challenges. In doing so we advance our mission to give care teams superpowers with software.

Canvas is institutionally backed by some of the greatest technology investors in the world (funded notable health tech companies such as GoodRx, Oscar Health, and Hims & Hers Health).

sections.title: Role Description
paras: We're hiring a Solutions Consultant to join our Growth team and bridge the gap between customer needs and platform capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of customer empathy, sales strategy, and technical execution, helping providers and care teams see the real value of Canvas Medical's EMR by transforming their workflows into working solutions during the sales process.

As a Solutions Consultant, you'll engage directly with prospects, customers, and internal stakeholders to identify the workflows that matter most to their operations. You'll translate these insights into end-to-end solution proposals and build MVP versions of those solutions using Canvas's customization tools, so prospects can see their future workflows running on the platform before they sign. You'll also develop and deploy agents alongside prospective customers as part of the sales process, putting working automation directly into their hands. Your primary building method will be AI and agent-assisted development, using tools like Claude Code to move from discovery to working plugin quickly.

The ideal candidate brings deep curiosity about healthcare technology and genuine comfort with AI-assisted development. You don't need formal software development experience, though it's certainly preferred. What matters is that you're comfortable with AI tooling, excited about applying new tools as they emerge, and eager to see how agent-assisted development evolves. You'll thrive in ambiguity, move quickly during active sales cycles, and collaborate closely with both sales and technical teams.

sections.title: Customer Discovery & Solution Design
bullets: Engage directly with prospects, customers, and internal partners to identify the clinical and operational workflows that drive their business
Translate workflow insights into clear, end-to-end solution proposals that show prospects exactly how Canvas will work for them
Balance what a prospect needs today with what will scale as they grow
Document learnings and contribute to internal knowledge-sharing to elevate team effectiveness

sections.title: Technical Prototyping & Platform Development
bullets: Build MVP versions of proposed solutions as Canvas plugins using agent-assisted development tools such as Claude Code
Develop and deploy agents with prospective customers during the sales process, turning proposed workflows into live automation they can evaluate firsthand
Demonstrate working prototypes during the sales process, showing fluency in event-driven design, handlers, and effects
Iterate rapidly on prototypes based on prospect feedback during active sales cycles
Create and maintain reusable solution patterns and playbooks that accelerate future engagements

sections.title: Cross-Functional Collaboration & Delivery
bullets: Collaborate across sales, customer success, implementation, engineering, and product teams to align on proposals, handoffs, and feedback loops
Bridge business and technical contexts to move deals forward effectively
Surface and track quality signals (proposal-to-close flow, prototype adoption, prospect feedback) to inform iteration
Shadow senior team members while progressively owning lower-complexity engagements independently

Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence . As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

sections.title: About the Role:

This is a hands-on role: you will run multiple concurrent workstreams and keep them moving without dropping the ball. You’ll be involved with sales kickoff execution, GTM onboarding, weekly training preparation and scheduling, creating content and tools, as well as continuous improvement using automation.

This role reports to the Director of Revenue Enablement and acts as a thought partner with the rest of the Revenue Operations team. You like to have fun at work, be creative, and solve problems in new ways. You are excited to use AI to build automations and create cool tools for the field.

sections.title: What You’ll Be Working On:
bullets: Program and Project Management: Build and maintain programs that help drive revenue such as quarterly certification programs, special projects to support new products and product features, programs that support SDR development, programs to improve processes, and Revenue Operations key initiatives.

Sales Kickoff (SKO): Assist on the end-to-end SKO logistics and planning. Assist in producing the “final show” and coordinating all the presenters, presentations, and recordings, etc. Bring your creativity to make the event fun and memorable.

Enablement Systems & Process: Build and maintain the systems, trackers, learning paths, communication cadences, interactivities, and automations that keep the sales org current. Monitor tool usage and evaluate effectiveness. Decide what tooling actually fits the team's needs, rather than defaulting to whatever exists today.

Onboarding Program Management: Build and maintain structured onboarding workbooks, ramp plans, first-90-days curricula and manage access and review cycles for onboarding materials. Build and facilitate in-person training and onboarding.

Partner Enablement & Certification Tracking: Assist in partner training trackers and compliance reporting, manage certification deadlines, and be the go-to for the field on how to use tracking tools correctly.

sections.title: What You Bring to the Team:
bullets: 4-7+ years in sales/revenue enablement, sales operations, or a sales-methodology-heavy role, within a high growth, B2B technology environment.

Deep working knowledge of sales methodology: hands-on experience with frameworks like MEDDPICC, SPICED, or BANT, and comfort making judgment calls on how they translate into CRM fields and process documentation.

Technical fluency: comfortable learning cloud, AI, and infrastructure concepts well enough to translate them into sales-usable processes and content. You have the curiosity and drive to want to learn the product so that you can teach it to others.
SKO or event planning experience: has helped plan or run a sales kickoff or similar event: logistics, agenda-building, cross-functional coordination, production start to finish.

Program and project management expertise: demonstrated to build and run effective programs that drive revenue. And an ability to run concurrent workstreams across tools like Monday.com , Slack, and Google Workspace.

Communication & presence: confident working with AEs, SEs, RevOps, Product, Engineering, and leadership; can run a room and write a clear field-facing update. Is comfortable facilitating, training, and running weekly sales “shows” to the entire GTM department.
Dashboards: Comfort with building dashboards in SFDC or tools like Grafana a plus.

paras: Access Reviews is one of our most widely adopted products — the surface where customers prove, to auditors and to themselves, that the right people have the right access. It's used by compliance and IT teams and by the managers who review access on a cycle and want to spend as little time in it as possible.

As Product Manager, Access Reviews , you'll own the next chapter: moving reviews from something people complete to something that largely runs itself. Agents configure, scope and run reviews through our API and MCP. AI makes the obvious decisions. Humans step in only where judgment is genuinely required. And the definition of what can be reviewed expands — from applications to identities, policies, and the non-human identities and AI agents now operating inside every enterprise.

This is a customer-facing product role with real ownership: strategy, quarterly plan, craft, and outcomes. You'll report to the Head of Product and work closely with engineering, design, and our customer-facing teams.

sections.title: ✨ Your Responsibilities
bullets: Agent-first reviews. Own the agentic core of the product: agents that configure, scope, launch and run reviews via API and MCP, and reviews triggered by events rather than calendars. This is the primary focus of the role.

Autonomous decisioning and reviewer trust. Make AI a trusted teammate — auto-decisioning where the answer is unambiguous, clear reasoning where it isn't, and a review experience people advocate for rather than tolerate.

Expand what can be certified. Take reviews beyond applications: identity-centric reviews, policy reviews, and reviews over non-human identities and AI agents — a governance problem the industry has not yet solved.

Roadmap and quarterly plan. Own the strategy and quarterly gameplan for a critical product surface, and make the trade-offs between new review coverage, agentic depth, and fitting how customers actually operate.
Compliance credibility. Ensure what we ship produces defensible, audit-ready evidence — the product has to hold up in a real audit, not just look rigorous.
Customer and field partnership. Work directly with customers, prospects and our field teams, and turn what you learn there into product decisions.

sections.title: 🙌 What We Value
paras: While specific qualifications matter less than your drive and judgment, these experiences will set you up for success:
bullets: Product management experience owning a customer-facing product with real business impact attached — not an internal platform
Experience with compliance, audit, governance or risk workflows, or an adjacent high-volume human-decision product (fraud and risk review, case management, approvals)

Shipped AI into production workflows where trust determined adoption — you've dealt with explainability, confidence, and what happens when the model is wrong, and you can reason about how you evaluated whether a recommendation was good enough to act on

You work AI-natively yourself. You use AI daily in your own craft — research synthesis, prototyping, writing specs, interrogating data — and you have real opinions on where it earns its place and where it doesn't. We'll ask you to show us how you work
A track record of changing user behavior, not just shipping features: you can point to a metric that moved because of a decision you made
Strong product craft and design partnership — comfortable in the details of a table, a queue, a decision flow
Comfortable in front of customers and auditors

MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. Our high-performing, customer-obsessed team runs on curiosity, communication, and accountability—working together to create exceptional experiences for our owners and guests. Whether solving big challenges, delivering outstanding results, or celebrating wins, we approach every day with purpose and passion. If you’re ready to join a mission-driven company where every teammate has the opportunity to thrive, Evolve might just be the place for you.

sections.title: Why this role
paras: Evolve’s Protection Programs help protect homeowners, guests, and Evolve from the unexpected. Programs such as damage protection, travel insurance, and chargeback insurance can reduce financial risk and give customers greater confidence throughout a reservation.

These programs sit at the intersection of product experience, commercial performance, and operational risk. Their success depends on more than a well-designed user flow: the right coverage, pricing, eligibility, partner economics, distribution, claims experience, and operational processes all need to work together. Evolve is looking for a product leader who can shape this portfolio as a durable business while making protection simple and valuable for customers.

As Principal Product Manager, you’ll own the strategy and roadmap for Protection Programs end to end. You’ll identify where protection can create value for customers and Evolve, build and optimize program economics with Commercial and partner teams, and lead cross-functional delivery with Design, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders.

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Protection Programs, connecting customer value, risk reduction, and sustainable business performance.
Build a deep understanding of homeowners, guests, internal teams, and insurance or protection partners; identify where protection addresses meaningful needs across the reservation lifecycle.
Develop a portfolio strategy across offerings such as damage protection, travel insurance, and chargeback insurance, including where to invest, expand, refine, or retire programs.

Own the commercial model for programs in partnership with Commercial, Finance, and external partners. Evaluate pricing, conversion, coverage, partner economics, claims costs, and operational expense to improve sustainable contribution.

Identify and validate growth opportunities, including customer segments, distribution moments, packaging, pricing, and partner capabilities; translate them into clear business cases and measurable product bets.

Improve the end-to-end experience, from understanding and selecting protection through purchase, servicing, cancellation, and claim, while making coverage terms, eligibility, and customer expectations clear.
Partner with Commercial and go-to-market teams on positioning, packaging, channel strategy, and enablement so programs are compelling, accurately represented, and easy to sell or adopt.
Work with Operations, Claims, Support, Legal, Compliance, and partners to make program rules and service processes reliable, scalable, and aligned with applicable requirements.

sections.title: What makes you a great fit
bullets: Minimum 10 years of product management experience, including 0-to-1 product buildouts and ownership of strategy and delivery for complex products or product areas.

Strong commercial judgment and experience owning or materially shaping a product’s business model. You can evaluate revenue, margin or contribution, pricing, adoption, partner economics, and cost-to-serve alongside customer outcomes.
A track record of turning ambiguous opportunities into focused strategies, business cases, roadmaps, and measurable results.

Experience building products that involve financial risk, insurance, payments, lending, warranties, fraud or disputes, or other regulated or partner-dependent services; direct insurance experience is a plus.
Ability to connect product decisions to go-to-market execution, including customer segmentation, positioning, packaging, distribution, and sales or channel enablement.
Strong customer discovery skills and the ability to balance customer needs with business viability, risk controls, partner requirements, and operational realities.
Experience working closely with external partners and internal teams such as Commercial, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Support, Design, and Engineering.
Comfort using product and financial data to set success measures, assess program performance, understand unit economics, and make evidence-based investment decisions.

sections.title: Location
paras: All Evolve team members must live in one of our approved locations by their first day. We can hire from anywhere in the U.S. except D.C. and Hawaii. Some positions may also have restrictions based on compensation in the following states: California, Maryland, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, and Washington. If you live in Colorado, you can work remotely anywhere in the state, at our downtown Denver office, or a hybrid of both! If you're planning to move soon, please let us know, and we'll be happy to review your application again.
California Applicant Privacy Policy | Evolve

sections.title: Job Overview
paras: We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the product strategy and end-to-end experience for Buying & Invoicing. You’ll build scalable, policy-driven purchasing and invoicing capabilities while supporting the transition from legacy platforms to a future Source-to-Pay (S2P) ecosystem.

Own the end-to-end experience across intake, requisitions, approvals, purchase orders, receipts, invoices, matching, exception handling, and final approvals.
Lead product decisions for modern purchasing and invoicing capabilities that replace legacy processes.
Translate Procurement, Finance, Compliance, and user needs into cohesive product capabilities and prioritized backlogs.
Embed policies, approval authority, contractual requirements, financial controls, segregation of duties, auditability, and exception management into product workflows.
Drive straight-through processing and automation while maintaining required business and financial controls.
Manage critical product dependencies across suppliers, sourcing, contracts, buying, invoicing, master data, and integrations.
Partner with Business, Finance, Procurement, Architecture, Engineering, and Controls teams throughout design, development, testing, launch, and stabilization.

sections.title: What You Bring
bullets: Extensive, senior-level product management experience, with demonstrated expertise in Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Source-to-Pay (S2P), procurement technology, or financial workflow products.
Comprehensive understanding of requisitions, approvals, purchase orders, receipts, invoicing, matching, and exception management.
Experience with enterprise ERP and procurement ecosystems, such as Oracle and SAP Ariba.
Experience designing products with complex workflows, business rules, approvals, and embedded controls.
Demonstrated ability to lead products spanning multiple systems and organizational boundaries.

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

greenhouse:gomaestro:8404433.summary: Maestro is the AI-powered operating system for private equity value creation: the system of record, action and intelligence that PE sponsors and their portfolio companies use to plan, execute, report on, and measure the impact of value creation. Purpose-built for how PE operates, Maestro brings value creation plans, KPIs, and execution together in one platform, giving sponsors and management teams a shared source of truth across the portfolio. With Maia, our native agentic AI for private equity, Maestro turns structured value creation context into earlier signals, faster insights, and action. Trusted by leading PE firms and supporting 60,000+ value creation initiatives across global organizations, Maestro is backed by S&P Global, Accordion Partners and several General Partners from the PE industry.

sections.title: About the role
paras: Maestro is a high-growth, AI-native technology company looking for a driven, experienced Client Success Manager (“CSM”) to join our Client Organization. With a growing roster of PE and corporate clients, we build long-lasting partnerships alongside strategic companies with a product that delivers significant and unique value.

As a CSM, you’ll be the primary contact for Maestro’s client relationships, acting as the point person managing client experiences end-to-end: onboarding, adoption, retention, and growth. You’ll learn the ins and outs of the Maestro platform, build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, and act as a strategic partner in value creation planning. This role is critical to ensuring our clients achieve maximum impact with Maestro.
This is a hybrid role (with some days in the office); preferred locations are New York City or Boston. This role reports to the VP, Client Development.

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Manage, maintain, and grow a book of client accounts, including global private equity firms, PE-backed portfolio companies, and corporate clients.
Cultivate an acute understanding of each client firm’s needs and goals related to Maestro; continuously provide solutions to meet and exceed those goals.
Act as a subject matter expert on value creation execution, sharing best practices that you’ll learn from the private equity ecosystem.
Meet regularly (virtual and live) with clients to review progress, drive outcomes, and foster impactful relationships.
Partner with internal teams to lead client onboardings, ensure proper setup, fast time-to-value, and delivery against the agreed-upon value proposition.
Develop and execute strategic account plans focused on adoption, retention, and growth; strategically leverage internal cross-functional teams for client support.
Lead periodic business reviews with client sponsors and executives to demonstrate value realized, share usage insights, and align on priorities for expansion.
Forecast renewals and proactively manage risk to exceed gross and net revenue retention and growth targets.

bullets: 3-5+ years of professional experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or another client-facing role (B2B SaaS experience preferred; Financial Technology, Transformation/Strategy Execution, or Collaborative Work Management software a plus).
Exposure to private equity, portfolio operations, management consulting, or a corporate transformation office is a strong plus.
Proven ability to build strong client relationships and deliver measurable results in adoption, retention, and growth.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage PE professionals and C-suite executives, including comfort discussing ROI and value realization.

Strong organizational and time management skills.
Experience with Salesforce and Microsoft Office (Slack, Zoom, etc. a plus).

Over 175 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with IDMe at 22 federal agencies, 50 state government agencies, and more than 100 healthcare organizations. This is a high-impact role suited for a driven, entrepreneurial individual who thrives in high-growth environments and is excited to help shape the future of healthcare.

You will also play a crucial role in building and operationalizing sales processes, tools, standard operating procedures, metrics, and other programs that improve seller effectiveness, productivity, and customer value. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, Product, Sales Operations, and Customer Success, to develop and execute scalable enablement programs that support revenue growth.

sections.title: About InterSystems
paras: InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. greenhouse:kodiak:4308530009.summary:
Kodiak AI, Inc. (Nasdaq: KDK), founded in 2018, is a leader in Physical AI, developing driverless technology that powers machines that move. Its Kodiak Driver is a vehicle-agnostic autonomous driving system that combines AI-powered software with modular hardware. Today it operates in long-haul trucking, industrial trucking, and defense. In 2024, Kodiak launched commercial Driver-as-a-Service operations with no one in the cab, and plans to launch driverless long-haul service between Dallas and Houston by the end of 2026.

Kodiak has partnered with many of the biggest names in freight, including Bosch for scaled hardware production, AWS, and leading customers including Atlas Energy Solutions, IKEA, Bridgestone, Werner Enterprises, C.R. England, Roehl Transport, and General Dynamics Land Systems.

sections.title: From the job description
paras: Kodiak is seeking a Staff Product Manager to serve as a strategic product leader for our Level 4 autonomous trucking platform across customer applications. This is a senior individual contributor role with organization-wide influence — you will not only own a critical product area end-to-end, but shape how Kodiak thinks about product strategy, customer deployment, and the path to scaled commercialization. You will be the most senior product voice in the room for your domain, setting direction that other PMs and cross-functional leaders align to, and operating as a trusted thought partner to the VP level and above.

The pay range listed below reflects the base salary in our SF/Silicon Valley location, across several internal levels. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors including: work location, experience, relevant training, education, skill level and performance during interview. Total compensation at Kodiak includes base pay, equity, bonus and a competitive benefits package
bullets: Product strategy and vision: Define the multi-year product roadmap for your area, grounded in customer needs, competitive dynamics, and Kodiak's commercialization trajectory. Make the case for what to build — and what not to — at the leadership level.

Cross-functional leadership: Unify Engineering, Program Management, Operations, and Commercial around a shared product vision. You are the person who resolves ambiguity and ensures the right tradeoffs are made with clarity and speed.
Execution at scale: Own the product lifecycle from opportunity identification through deployment and iteration — holding the bar on quality and metrics across multiple workstreams simultaneously.

Prioritization and resource influence: Set prioritization frameworks that others adopt. Actively shape engineering roadmap and resourcing conversations, advocating effectively for customer-critical investments at the VP and executive level.

Product definition: Author product requirements that set a high standard for rigor and customer fidelity. Partner deeply with Design and Engineering leadership to ensure architectural decisions reflect long-term product needs, not just near-term scope.

Performance and readiness: Define the metrics and readiness criteria that determine when a product is ready to deploy. Own the system of record for product health and communicate it credibly to customers, leadership, and the board.

Customer partnership: Serve as Kodiak's most senior product relationship owner with key customers — building deep trust, surfacing strategic feedback, and translating real-world operational complexity into product direction that engineering can act on.

Organizational impact: Mentor senior PMs, contribute to the product management craft at Kodiak, and help define how the PM function operates — from how requirements are written to how tradeoffs are communicated.

greenhouse:lightningai:8004138003.summary:
Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

sections.title: The Way We Work
paras: The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:
bullets: Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.
Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.
Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.
Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.
Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.
Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.

sections.title: Who We're Looking For
paras: We’re looking for a Product Manager, AI Infrastructure to own the product experience for Lightning AI’s GPU cloud, from capacity and provisioning through workload execution, reliability, observability, and customer consumption.

This role sits at the intersection of AI infrastructure, cloud platforms, and developer experience. You’ll define how customers discover, provision, configure, and operate GPU compute, while partnering closely with infrastructure engineering and operations to make the platform more reliable, efficient, and scalable.

The right candidate understands that infrastructure itself is the product. You should be comfortable reasoning about GPU availability and utilization, cluster provisioning, networking and storage, scheduling and orchestration, workload reliability, and the APIs and workflows that expose these systems to customers.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Own the product vision and roadmap for Lightning AI’s GPU cloud infrastructure.
Define how customers discover, provision, configure, and consume GPU compute.
Build product experiences around GPU capacity, clusters, scheduling, networking, storage, and workload execution.
Partner closely with infrastructure and platform engineering to improve availability, reliability, utilization, and performance.
Develop a deep understanding of customer workloads, from experimentation and training through inference, and translate those needs into infrastructure capabilities.
Use infrastructure and product data to identify capacity constraints, reliability issues, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.
Define the APIs, interfaces, and developer workflows through which customers interact with infrastructure.
Make product tradeoffs across customer experience, infrastructure efficiency, reliability, cost, and engineering complexity.

sections.title: What You’ll Need
bullets: 7+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years building cloud infrastructure, compute, platform, developer tooling, or AI infrastructure products.
Experience building technical products for developers, infrastructure teams, ML engineers, AI researchers, or other technical users.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts including compute, networking, storage, provisioning, scheduling, and orchestration.
Familiarity with GPU infrastructure and the requirements of large-scale AI training, experimentation, or inference workloads.
Technical depth to work directly with engineers on APIs, distributed systems, Kubernetes, workload orchestration, observability, and infrastructure reliability.
Experience using data to understand infrastructure utilization, capacity, reliability, performance, and customer behavior.
Track record of owning technical products from problem definition through launch and adoption.
Strong product judgment and ability to turn complex infrastructure capabilities into simple customer experiences.

greenhouse:mangroup:5027688101.summary: Man Group is a global alternative investment management firm focused on pursuing outperformance for sophisticated clients via our Systematic, Discretionary and Solutions offerings. sections.title: Discretionary Implementation Analyst
paras: The Discretionary Implementation Analyst will coordinate across front-, middle- and back-office teams to ensure the effective implementation and ongoing support of new and existing discretionary investment strategies.

The role combines day-to-day implementation oversight with longer-term process improvement. Key responsibilities include overseeing the use of trading and implementation systems, owning multi-manager rebalancing models, resolving time-critical implementation issues and driving strategic enhancements to discretionary infrastructure.

Working closely with portfolio managers, Technology and external counterparties, the analyst will deliver new business initiatives and use technology to automate and improve centralised portfolio management processes. A key focus will be supporting equity and credit portfolio management teams with order raising and trade implementation.

sections.title: Trading and portfolio implementation
bullets: Support order raising across equity and credit portfolio management teams, including complex single-ticket orders, portfolio rebalancing and futures rolls.
Coordinate the timely implementation of discretionary and multi-manager fund rebalances, strategy reallocations and new business requirements.
Coordinate the implementation of bespoke hedging and other non-standard portfolio management requirements for Solutions mandates.
Coordinate implementation activities arising from complex issuer events, fund restructurings and other non-standard trading situations.
Coordinate instructions for participation in new issues and obtain the required cross-trade approvals.
Act as a central point of contact for discretionary implementation issues, coordinating timely resolution and escalation across investment and support teams.

sections.title: Technology, infrastructure and process improvement
bullets: Leverage technology to enhance, automate and streamline daily investment management processes, reducing operational and trading risk.
Oversee the day-to-day use of trading and implementation systems, own multi-manager rebalancing models, and coordinate issue resolution and enhancements with Technology.
Design and implement reporting that provides portfolio management teams with the information needed to manage their strategies effectively.
Define operating models for new asset classes and coordinate the setup and integration of new funds, asset classes and bespoke processes across front-, middle- and back-office teams.
Assess the operational implications of bespoke terms, including complex fee structures, support their negotiation with relevant stakeholders, and coordinate implementation.
Develop and maintain cash management processes and overdraft governance frameworks across the discretionary fund range.

greenhouse:mavenclinic:8860743002.summary: Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak…

sections.title: About the Role:
paras: Care Delivery is the infrastructure that powers how Maven members access care and how our providers deliver it. Every program we run across maternity, fertility, menopause, and pediatrics, depends on it. It's where clinical workflows, provider tooling, and the systems that make care measurable, billable, and scalable at Maven's scale all come together.

We're looking for a Product Manager to help build that platform: the EHR and clinical tooling, provider workflows, messaging, and the data and billing infrastructure that turn Maven's care model into something reliable and scalable. You'll own defined capabilities within the platform and drive them from problem to shipped, in close partnership with engineering, clinical, design, and operations. It's a high-leverage seat. What you build here touches every program Maven offers.
You'll report to the Group Product Manager, Care Delivery, and work closely with our providers, as well as Clinical Product, Member Experience, Operations, and the Data and AI Platform teams.

sections.title: What You’ll Do:
bullets: Own specific Care Delivery capabilities end-to-end, provider workflows, clinical documentation, messaging, scheduling and matching, or quality and billing infrastructure, from problem definition through launch and iteration.
Make crisp, well-reasoned product decisions, especially where clinical accuracy and provider experience are both at stake.

Use AI hands-on to move faster, prototyping with AI tools to test ideas and pressure-test flows before committing engineering time, and identify and build AI-powered capabilities into the care delivery platform where they genuinely improve the provider or member experience.
Partner daily with engineering and design to ship reliable platform capabilities, and with clinical and operations partners so that what you build works for real providers and members.
Translate regulatory and quality requirements, like HEDIS measures and clinical coding, into clean product experiences that add value without adding friction.
Instrument what you ship, watch how it performs, and iterate. Bring data to every decision.
Build platform primitives, reusable capabilities that serve many programs, rather than one-off features.
Bring a point of view on how AI can improve care delivery workflows, and put it to work in how you build.

sections.title: What You’ll Bring:
paras: The base salary range for this role is 155,000-185,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.

Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. This role is open to candidates in remote locations with a strong preference for San Francisco, CA; secondary locations include Seattle, WA and New York, NY.

Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend quarterly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.
bullets: 3+ years in product management, ideally with some time in healthcare tech or another complex, regulated, or operations-heavy domain.
A strong executor: you take ambiguous problems, break them down, and ship, without needing everything defined for you.
Solid data instincts: you define the right metrics, work with real datasets, and communicate findings clearly to both clinical and commercial audiences.

Comfort with technical and clinical complexity: you can hold your own in an engineering sprint and a clinical review, and you're eager to learn the domain fast (FHIR, interoperability, EHR workflows).
Genuine care for providers and members: the people using what you build show up in your decisions.
Clear, direct communication and strong cross-functional collaboration.

Fluency with AI and a genuine desire to build with it: you understand how modern AI models work well enough to know where they're reliable and where they aren't, you reach for AI tools to prototype and think, and you're excited to ship AI-powered features rather than just talk about them.
Bonus: experience with EHR or EMR systems, clinical workflows, healthcare interoperability, or provider-facing tools.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Our Sr. Account Managers, Paid Search are responsible for driving KPI improvements and developing cutting-edge strategies tailored to client goals. Your core responsibilities in this role include strategy development, tactical execution, and management of client relationships.
bullets: Taking on clients in month 1, you will build & optimize Google and Bing search campaigns for a roster of B2B, lead generation, and/or ecommerce clients across various industries
Client assignments will be a mix of leading paid search efforts on small-spending clients and acting as a supporting paid search team member on medium to enterprise clients
Define, monitor and analyze trends in clients’ KPIs
Develop both short & long term paid search strategy based on client-specific goals
Actively test and analyze keywords, advertising copy, landing pages, campaign types and positioning to drive results in line with client's goals
Communicate performance results and strategy recommendations to clients clearly & secure buy-in from decision-makers
Create slides with good design & strong storytelling for clients
Create quarterly business reviews & other client-facing presentations that outline performance, insights from testing, and key strategic opportunities

sections.title: About You
paras: This role is subject to our Return to Office (RTO) policy. If you reside within a commutable distance of one of our office locations, you will be expected to work from the office a set number of days per week. The specific details, including the number of required office days, will be in accordance with the company’s then-current RTO policy, which is subject to change from time to time.

greenhouse:monsterenergy:4342098009.summary:
As a Regional Account Manager, you’ll play a key role in accelerating Monster Energy’s growth across Canada. Working closely with Coca-Cola, our distribution partner, and key regional customers, you’ll help implement Monster Energy’s commercial strategies, identify growth opportunities, influence customer plans, and turn strategy into strong execution at retail.

This is a highly collaborative sales role for someone who thrives on building relationships, influencing outcomes, and connecting strategy to execution. You’ll work across Monster Energy, Coca-Cola and our customers to expand distribution, strengthen execution, and drive sustainable sales growth.

sections.title: A Day in the Life:
paras: Success in this role means becoming a trusted partner to Coca-Cola and our customers while being a strong champion of Monster Energy’s strategies and priorities. You’ll combine strong sales instincts, relationships and influence to identify opportunities, shape plans and turn strategy into action. You’ll be someone who sees what’s possible, brings solutions forward and works collaboratively across organizations to deliver great execution in the market.

sections.title: The Impact You'll Make:
bullets: Implement Monster Energy’s commercial strategies within assigned accounts, partnering closely with Coca-Cola and customers to translate priorities into actionable plans and strong execution at retail.
Build strong relationships with Coca-Cola and key regional customers, creating alignment around opportunities, priorities and execution.
Partner with Coca-Cola to bring Monster Energy’s strategies to life, helping develop customer plans that drive growth and strengthen our position in the market.
Identify and pursue growth opportunities across distribution, assortment, merchandising, promotions and in-store execution.
Influence and collaborate across multiple stakeholders, connecting Monster Energy, Coca-Cola and customer priorities to move opportunities forward.
Champion execution, working with Coca-Cola and internal partners to ensure agreed plans translate into results at retail.
Stay close to the market, developing a strong understanding of customers, consumers, competitors and emerging retail trends to identify where Monster Energy can win.
Bring solutions, not just information, sharing insights, ideas and recommendations that help the business make better decisions and capitalize on opportunities.

sections.title: Who You Are:
paras: Monster Energy provides competitive total compensation. The estimated annual salary range for this position is listed below. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, qualifications, experience, and work location.

Monster Energy uses AI-powered tools, including Greenhouse’s Talent Matching feature, to help evaluate applications for this role. To learn more see Monster’s privacy policy here Privacy Policy or contact Monster at privacy@monsterenergy.com.
bullets: 5+ years of progressive sales or account management experience within CPG, retail, beverage, broker or distributor environments
Strong relationship-building, communication, presentation and influencing skills
Ability to work collaboratively across customers, Coca-Cola and internal teams
Strong sales and business mindset with the ability to identify opportunities and turn strategy into action
Proactive, solutions-oriented and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and organizations
Proficiency with Excel, Word and PowerPoint
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience

greenhouse:ocrolusinc:6149765004.summary:
Come build at the intersection of AI and fintech. At Ocrolus, we’re on a mission to help lenders automate workflows with confidence—streamlining how financial institutions evaluate borrowers and enabling faster, more accurate lending decisions.

Our AI workflow and analytics platform for lenders is trusted at scale, processing nearly one million credit applications every month across small business, mortgage, and consumer lending. By integrating state-of-the-art open- and closed-source AI models with our human-in-the-loop verification engine, Ocrolus captures data from financial documents with over 99% accuracy. Thanks to our advanced fraud detection and comprehensive cash flow and income analytics, our customers achieve greater efficiency in risk management, and provide expanded access to credit—ultimately creating a more inclusive financial system.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Partner closely with the GM of Mortgage and cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Revenue/Sales, and Customer Success) to define and drive the mortgage enablement strategy and roadmap — with significant independence in how you execute it.

Build the enablement function from scratch : design, build, and deliver scalable onboarding and education programs focused on using Ocrolus to originate mortgages — instructor-led trainings, on-demand eLearning, role-based learning paths, technical playbooks, integration guides, and customer certification programs.

Create a progressive, modular curriculum that maps directly to the mortgage origination workflow, with role-based learning paths that enable end users to steadily build proficiency across our full mortgage solution.
Produce hands-on materials: sandbox exercises, labs, demo scripts, templates, runbooks, and checklists that shorten time-to-value and reduce launch friction.
Run kickoffs, launch workshops, technical deep dives, and train-the-trainer sessions for customers, partners, and internal teams — including live, client-facing training sessions .
Partner with Product and Engineering to rapidly learn new capabilities and translate complex features into practical how-to guidance and integration patterns.
Work with Revenue/Sales and Product Marketing to define onboarding readiness criteria and pre/post-sale enablement materials tied to launch success metrics.
Measure enablement effectiveness with KPIs (time-to-production, launch velocity, adoption, CSAT, certification completion, support deflection) and iterate based on data and feedback.

sections.title: What you'll bring
bullets: 5–10+ years of experience in L&D, client enablement, customer training, or implementation programs — with the seniority to operate as a function of one and build from zero.
A track record of working with independence — you don't need a team around you to move fast and deliver high-quality outcomes.
Strong cross-functional stakeholder management — you're equally effective collaborating with Product and Engineering as you are presenting to customers; this is not a back-office role.
Mortgage industry exposure (e.g., underwriting, operations, LOS work, or mortgage product experience).
A passion for education and curriculum design — you love creating learning experiences and measuring outcomes.
Ability to translate product features into concrete workflows that teach customers how to originate loans using our platform — and to learn our product deeply and quickly .
Strong presentation and facilitation skills — comfortable delivering both live (including direct client-facing sessions) and asynchronous training.
Experience producing customer-facing documentation and training artifacts (playbooks, runbooks, templates).

sections.title: Nice-to-haves
bullets: Prior experience at a fintech or AI-driven company.
Hands-on experience with LOS or point solutions (Encompass, Ellie Mae, or equivalent) or integrations into LOS/AUS.
Experience with LMS tools, eLearning authoring (Articulate/Camtasia), and building certification programs.
Instructional design background or training certification.
Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites for launches and workshops.

sections.title: Life at Ocrolus
paras: We’re a team of builders, thinkers, and problem solvers who care deeply about our mission — and each other. As a fast-growing, remote-first company, we offer an environment where you can grow your skills, take ownership of your work, and make a meaningful impact.

Our culture is grounded in four core values:
Empathy – Understand and serve with compassion
Curiosity – Explore new ideas and question the status quo
Humility – Listen, be grounded, and remain open-minded
Ownership – Love what you do, work hard, and deliver excellence

We believe diverse perspectives drive better outcomes. That’s why we’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone has a seat at the table, regardless of race, gender, gender identity, age, disability, national origin, or any other protected characteristic.

greenhouse:opentable:8931488002.summary:
With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

sections.title: About the job:
paras: OpenTable is seeking an Account Manager responsible for leading customer retention and revenue growth within your territory of restaurants, reporting to the Manager, Account Managers. In this role, you will be in tune with the local restaurant industry and proactively engage with restaurant customers to serve as a trusted advisor. You will be innovative in overcoming customer obstacles, provide constructive perspectives to challenge current thinking, and use our world-class technology to empower restaurants to focus on their team, their guests, and their bottom line.

sections.title: Responsibilities:
bullets: Cultivate and build upon existing high-level relationships to serve as a trusted advisor to restaurants and lead retention rates by aiding in re-signing customers with expired contracts.

Account Retention & Revenue Growth: Build and maintain strategic relationships with restaurant leadership to achieve quarterly retention and upsell targets, including contract renewals and premium marketing tool adoption.
Understand customer needs, identify sales opportunities to sell premium marketing tools, and achieve quarterly company goals and sales objectives.
Assist restaurant management with system configuration to optimize reservation flow.
Build and utilize data-driven presentations for ongoing business reviews and educate operators about industry trends using actionable, data-driven insights.
Act as an advocate and high-level point of contact for restaurant customer concerns and resolve cross-functional issues.
Track weekly meeting and call activity in Salesforce, conduct monthly meetings with Elite members, and capture product upgrade feedback for the team.

sections.title: Minimum Qualifications:
bullets: 2-3+ years of account management or equivalent experience in a restaurant/hospitality environment with validated customer service skills.

Residency in the Pacific Time Zone or Hawaii-Aleutian Time Zone to align with the team and market. Seattle or Hawaii residence strongly preferred. Domestic travel will be required throughout West Coast and Hawaii.
Deep expertise in restaurant operations and management, including comprehension of P&L and financial statements.
Proven ability to handle objections and comfort leading consultative sales conversations to achieve retention and revenue goals.
Strong writing, presentation, social, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with confidence delivering training and speaking to groups.
Valid driver’s license and transportation, with residency in Hawaii, Pacific, or Mountain Time Zones to align with the territory and team.

sections.title: Preferred Qualifications:
bullets: College degree in a relevant field.
Experience using AI tools to draft and personalize outreach, research accounts, capture interaction data, and determine future strategy.
Knowledge of Google Suite, Salesforce, and Apple products and operating systems.
Experience collaborating with marketing teams to help design and execute restaurant-specific marketing programs and promotional participation.
Demonstrated ability to keenly track economic and industry drivers and thrive in an unstructured, forward-thinking environment.

greenhouse:pagerduty:6141657004.summary: PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
bullets: Build technical champions at customer accounts through standalone meetings and conversations, working closely with AEs to identify and grow them.

Own the Proof of Value (POV) process end-to-end: identify the business case with the AE, scope use cases and success criteria, document deliverables and timelines, and deliver both technical and final POV presentations.
Conduct workshop meetings that include deep-dive technical discovery, tying the technical solution to business value, visualizing current and future states, and delivering recommendations.
Prepare and deliver custom demos tailored to unique customer pain points, partnering with automation engineers on complex scenarios.
Conduct lightweight Operations Cloud Lifecycle Assessments (OCLA) with customers.
Effectively converse and persuade at a technical level with practitioners (SREs, developers, MIMs), and handle functional and competitive objections.
Articulate PagerDuty's differentiators relative to a customer's current and future state, incorporating them into POVs and custom demonstrations.
Break down complex technical concepts and explain them clearly to audiences ranging from DevOps engineers to business stakeholders.

Develop prompts and structured extraction workflows for document understanding, classification, summarization, and business process automation.
Build Python services and APIs that integrate AI capabilities with customer applications, databases, and enterprise data sources.
Create representative evaluation datasets and automated tests to measure accuracy, grounding, extraction quality, and agent task completion; validate changes before release.

sections.title: What is The Role
bullets: Redesign how Security is packaged and priced on Serverless. Define the tiers, feature entitlements, and usage meters, select what is bundled, metered, or sold as an add-on, test the options against customer demand and COGS, and bring a recommendation to senior executive team.

Own margin. Work with the Platform team and Finance to model the cost of new security capabilities, including ingest, search, retention, endpoint, and AI features, and set pricing requirements before a feature ships.

Grow Security on Serverless from proof of concept to renewal. You are accountable for new workloads, migrations from hosted and self-managed deployments, expansion, and retention. Work with Finance to separate recurring growth from one-time proof-of-concept revenue.

Give customers control over cost and performance. Define how search configurations, data tiers, and retention work for security use cases, and bring the cost models that justify new platform levers. Keep tenant-level packaging consistent with the Product Manager for MSSP and multi-tenancy.

Simplify how customers understand cost. Cut packaging complexity first, then simplify the sizing and pricing estimators that customers and Solutions Architects use. Agree on a measure of "simple," such as time to a credible quote, and track it.

Turn pricing decisions into shipped product. Write the PRDs and PRFAQs, and lead the work across Security engineering, the Serverless Platform team, Billing and Metering, and Cloud Operations. Help build the frameworks and reviews that other Security PMs, Product Marketing, and Solutions Architects use to price new capabilities.

Stay close to the market and the field. Discuss with customers and prospects about what they will and won't pay for, track how other security platforms package and price, and help the field explain when Serverless, hosted, or self-managed is the right fit.
You know the main approaches to pricing AI features, such as token-based, credit-based, and per-action or outcome pricing, and how inference costs and unpredictable usage shape each one.
