sections.title: ACTIVE SECRET OR TS CLEARANCES ONLY.
paras: Rhombus is building technology for some of the hardest problems in national security. We work directly with government and defense customers to turn complex operational problems into deployed capabilities—and then make those capabilities better, faster, and more useful in the field. We're looking for an early-career, super motivated, Product Manager who understands how the US Air Force actually resources, acquires, and deploys capability.
This is not a traditional SaaS product management role.

You will not spend your days managing a backlog, writing Jira tickets, or optimizing a commercial software funnel within a large distributed team. Instead, you'll operate at the intersection of defense mission requirements, Air Force resourcing and PPBE, software, data, and relentless execution. You will sit directly with customers, understand what they are trying to accomplish, translate that into technical and operational solutions, and personally drive those solutions from concept to deployment, owning every part of the process.

sections.title: What you'll do
paras: We need your help in taking Rhombus capabilities from zero to one—and from one to deployed, adopted, and operationally valuable.

Your work will span product, technology, customer engagement, and defense program execution. In a typical week, you might be working with an Air Force stakeholder to understand a complex resourcing challenge, writing Python to analyze a dataset, translating a customer need into product requirements, troubleshooting a deployment with an engineer, preparing for a senior government meeting, and figuring out why something that worked in the lab is not working in the field. All the while, keeping internal colleagues updated on progress (including senior leaders and executive team members). Expect that most of your days per week will be spent in the Pentagon.
bullets: Work directly with defense customers to understand mission needs, operational constraints, resourcing challenges, and opportunities to improve how capabilities are delivered.
Translate ambiguous mission problems into executable solutions, working across product, engineering, data, SMEs, deployment, QA, and customer-facing teams.
Drive execution relentlessly. When something is blocking a customer or mission, you own getting it unstuck—even when the solution falls outside a traditional product manager's job description.
Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Air Force resourcing, PPBE, programming, budgeting, requirements, acquisition, and capability delivery.
Turn customer and operational requirements into clear product requirements, workflows, technical specifications, and implementation plans.

Use Python and data directly to investigate problems, analyze operational information, automate tasks, and develop a working understanding of the systems you are helping build. Resolve deployment issues.
Work closely with engineers and technical teams throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements through deployment and troubleshooting.

Go to the field and stay close to users, building trust that we can deliver on goal. Understand how Rhombus products are actually being used, identify friction, and rapidly turn feedback into improvements. You have a particular knack for documentation!

sections.title: What we're looking for
paras: We are looking for high-potential, early-career operators, not finished products. You may have a few years of experience and still have a lot to learn. That's expected. What matters is that you learn quickly, take ownership, and have the judgment and technical foundation to contribute immediately.

sections.title: Required
bullets: Active Secret or Top Secret clearance REQUIRED
U.S. citizenship.

Approximately 2–5 years of relevant professional experience in defense, national security, the military, government technology, defense technology, software, or a similarly demanding technical environment.

Working knowledge of Air Force or DoD resourcing and PPBE, including an understanding of how requirements, programming, budgeting, acquisition, and funding decisions translate into actual capabilities.

Ability to read and write Python. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable getting into code, manipulating data, writing scripts, and troubleshooting technical problems yourself.
Experience working with technical teams and a working understanding of the software development lifecycle.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate credibly with both engineers and government customers.
Demonstrated ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the answer is not obvious and there is no established playbook.

paras: Custom objects allow businesses to define custom data models in Stripe, ensuring Stripe reflects how their business operates. A business might have data that doesn’t fit standard Stripe objects, such as Shipments, Reservations, or InsurancePolicies. Once defined in Stripe, that custom data can be used with Stripe-native objects, such as Customers, Subscriptions, and Invoices. Companies can keep their existing system of record and bring over what their Stripe integration needs, or use custom objects as the system of record for that data.
Custom objects are the data pillar of Stripe’s extensibility platform, which consists of Stripe Apps, Stripe Workflows, scripts, and extension points.
We’re hiring a product manager to lead our custom objects product, which will make it easy for anyone to model, ingest, and use data on Stripe.

These are technical, high-value, long-cycle deals where the sale is won or lost on credibility: whether we can architect the right cluster, model the real TCO, prove performance, and de-risk a customer's move onto our platform.

sections.title: Why this role exists
paras: This person owns the technical win. They build and lead the sales engineering function that turns "interested" into signed, multi-year committed-capacity contracts, and they set the pre-sales bar as we scale headcount and deal volume.

This is not a demo-jockey role. We need someone who has genuinely stood up training and inference workloads, argued interconnect topology with a customer's ML infra lead, and closed large deals with cycles measured in quarters, not weeks.

sections.title: Lead and build the SE / Solutions Architect team
bullets: Hire, coach, and retain a team of sales engineers and solutions architects; define the pre-sales operating model as the org scales.

Set and hold a technical quality bar across the team; run enablement so every SE can speak credibly to GPU architecture, networking, and orchestration.

sections.title: Own the technical win in large, complex deals
bullets: Partner with Account Executives as the technical lead on strategic and enterprise opportunities from discovery through technical close.
Run qualification with a real methodology (MEDDPICC or equivalent) — surface the economic buyer, decision criteria, and the technical champion, and build the win plan around them.
Architect solutions across compute, networking, storage, and orchestration; produce sizing, capacity plans, and TCO comparisons vs. hyperscalers and self-build.
Design and drive POCs/POVs: define success criteria up front, run benchmarks, and convert results into commercial momentum.

sections.title: Be the Technical voice of the Customer internally

smartrecruiters:mirantis:744000157429577.summary:
AI infrastructure is undergoing a generational shift. Disaggregated, raw GPU hardware must be transformed into multi-tenant, production-ready, and sovereign AI clouds - without locking enterprises into a single hyperscaler or hardware vendor. That is where k0rdent AI by Mirantis comes in.

k0rdent AI serves as the declarative "super control plane" that manages complex, heterogeneous GPU infrastructure from Metal-to-Model™. We are hiring a Head of Solutions Architecture to own the technical win, build our pre-sales organization from the ground up, and lead the architecture strategy on high-value, long-cycle compute deals.

sections.title: Job Description
paras: This is not a demo-jockey role . You will be an executive technical partner to NeoClouds, AI-native startups, enterprise AI teams, research labs, and sovereign buyers. You will lead high-stakes architecture debates on interconnect topologies, build TCO models that challenge hyperscaler economics, construct reusable pre-sales machinery, and shape our core product roadmap directly from field intelligence.
By joining us, you will lead the technical field engine behind k0rdent AI , shaping how the world's most innovative companies build and operate GPU-powered infrastructure at scale.
bullets:
Build & Scale the Pre-Sales Engine (40%)

• Hire, coach, and retain a world-class team of Solutions Architects and Field Engineers; establish the global pre-sales operating model as headcount and deal volume scale.
Build reusable, scalable field assets: discovery frameworks, reference architectures, TCO/benchmark models, POV playbooks, and RFP response libraries.
Set a high technical quality bar across the organization; run enablement so every SA can speak credibly to GPU architecture, high-speed fabrics, and container orchestration.

Own the Technical Win in Strategic Deals (40%)

• Partner with Account Executives as the technical executive on strategic enterprise opportunities with long sales cycles (6–18+ months) and multi-million-dollar ACV/TCV.
Execute structured qualification (MEDDPICC or equivalent) to map decision criteria, surface economic buyers, and build win plans around technical champions.
Architect end-to-end solutions across compute, networking, storage, and orchestration; deliver sizing, capacity plans, and TCO comparisons vs. public clouds and self-built alternatives.
Design and drive POVs/POCs: define strict success criteria upfront, run performance benchmarks, and convert results into commercial momentum.

Serve as the Technical Voice of the Customer (20%)

• Feed structured product, capacity, and feature requirements directly back to product management, engineering, and supply planning teams.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: Pre-sales leadership experience at a NeoCloud, hyperscaler AI organization, or accelerated-hardware vendor
Enterprise Deal Leadership: Proven track record leading technical sales in complex B2B environments, ideally with multi-year committed-capacity or reserved-capacity deal structures.

Player-Coach Leadership: Track record of hiring, developing, and leading Solutions Architecture or Field Engineering teams—with the technical depth to lead the room on hard deals while scaling others to do the same.

Hands-on AI/ML Infrastructure Experience: You have stood up or operated production ML workloads (distributed training and multi-node inference) and deeply understand performance bottlenecks across interconnect, memory bandwidth, I/O, and cluster scheduling.

NVIDIA Stack & High-Speed Fabric Mastery: Fluency across Hopper and Blackwell architectures (H100/H200, GB200 NVL72, B200) and reference systems (DGX, HGX, MGX). Deep understanding of NVLink/NVSwitch domains, InfiniBand, Spectrum-X Ethernet, RDMA/RoCE, and DPUs.
Hands-on experience with cloud-native orchestration for AI: Kubernetes (GPU operators, device plugins), KubeVirt, Metal3/Ironic bare-metal provisioning, and Slurm.
Familiarity with high-throughput parallel/object storage systems for AI pipelines and data center physical constraints (power, cooling, rack density).

We are seeking a Solution Consultant to partner with Sales and help enterprise customers address complex security, identity, access, asset visibility, exposure management, and risk challenges.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical and business advisor, leading discovery, solution design, product demonstrations, proof-of-value engagements, and customer validation activities. You will work directly with security, identity, infrastructure, IT, risk, and executive stakeholders to connect technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Partner with Sales to lead technical discovery, solution design, and customer validation.
Deliver compelling virtual and in-person technical demonstrations.
Deploy and support proof-of-value and proof-of-concept engagements.
Translate technical capabilities into business outcomes.

Develop customer-facing documentation, technical summaries, and solution narratives.
Lead technical training sessions based on customer use cases and POV findings.
Support marketing events, conferences, webinars, and speaking engagements.

sections.title: Required Qualifications
bullets: 5+ years of experience in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Pre-Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a related technical role.
5+ years of customer-facing technical, pre-sales, or customer support experience.
Experience supporting complex cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise platform sales cycles with enterprise customers.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts, identity and access, governance and risk, and security operations.

Strong presentation, storytelling, and executive communication skills.
